verdict.rationale: Mastra's own docs say its scaffolding command creates an agent harness with "recurring schedules", so the product ships some first-party recurring-scheduling capability. That is one thin mention, tied to the agent harness rather than explicitly to workflows. Nothing in the pack documents cron expressions, overlap policies, schedule pause/resume (the documented suspend/resume is human-in-the-loop, not schedule control), or a view of upcoming runs. missing for 10: cron-expression workflow scheduling, overlap/concurrency policies, pause/resume of schedules, visibility into upcoming scheduled runs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a backend developer, I schedule workflows on cron expressions with overlap policies, pause/resume, and visibility into upcoming runs

citations.quote: create a general-purpose agent harness with a local workspace, shell tools, memory, task tracking, web access, and recurring schedules
